Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the non-Taft president as Franklin D. Roosevelt. The web search results explicitly stated the band played for "President Theodore Roosevelt" (the 26th president, known as Teddy Roosevelt), not Franklin D. Roosevelt (the 32nd president). Because the Planner misidentified the president as FDR instead of Teddy Roosevelt, they subsequently provided the wrong spouse (Eleanor Roosevelt instead of Edith Roosevelt).
